notLaunchableReason: bin/agent-up has no launch branch for hermes yet; its launch and resume composition is framework-specific (see the claude/codex branches around bin/agent-up:1867-1948)

signals.comment: Confirmed by reading cli.py in the upstream checkout. Hermes renders a selection prompt for dangerous commands with the choices Allow once / Allow for this session / Add to permanent allowlist / Deny.
signals.compactComment: Confirmed at agent/conversation_loop.py:4770 — agent._safe_print("  ⟳ compacting context…"). Note that _build_compact_banner in cli.py is NOT this: it sizes a startup banner to the terminal width. The ellipsis is deliberately outside the pattern so a change in how it is rendered does not break the match.

acp.comment: Hermes also ships a full ACP server (hermes-acp, or `hermes acp`) advertising session fork/list/resume. Recorded for when HAFleet grows an ACP runtime; the tmux path above is what is wired today.
